name: Castellan Brannoch
role: Castellan of the Echo Bridge — holds the only crossing for miles for neither city, at a toll that never changes
appearance: A square, grey man in a bridge-warden's tabard that belongs to no city's colours. Stands in the middle of his bridge rather than at either end.
voiceHints: Exact, unhurried and unbribable. States the toll, states the law, and asks nothing else of you.
wants: The bridge held for neither city, and the name of whoever is poisoning his river.
fears: The day both cities stop offering to buy the bridge and start sending soldiers for it.
knowledge: Everyone who has crossed his bridge in eleven years, and which way
What Harmonic Heights and the Radiant Plateau each offered for the bridge
That the contamination in the river gets worse after certain nights, not certain days

reactsToReputation.honest: tells you what he has seen upriver
reactsToReputation.partisan-of-either-city: charges you the posted toll and watches your hands

questSeeds: Brannoch will trade a year's free crossing for the name of whoever is fouling the Echo River
One of the two cities has stopped offering and started planning
gear: a bridge-warden's tabard in no city's colours
title: Castellan of the Echo Bridge
_domainsWhy: exact truth, a held line, and a peace he keeps between two cities
